newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom bucks trend, shares post gains.
newsitem.headline: Telekom bucks trend, shares post gains.

text.p: Shares in German telephone monopoly Deutsche Telekom AG surged in active bourse dealings against the general market trend.
Telekom shares rose to a new record high of 37 marks and later traded up 1.15 marks at 36.80 marks. The 30-share DAX index, however, was down 67.10 points at 3,348.30 points.

Traders said Telekom shares were in favour because they have not fully participated in the broader market rally and were buying the share after taking profits in other sectors, notably in chemical and bank shares.
"Many dealers are underinvested in Telekom," said one trader, citing a reason for the interest in Telekom.
